title: Personal stories & process
description: Open with a specific tension or question. Keep enough context, show the real process, and end with a useful payoff.
strength: Platform forecast, not a cross-platform popularity ranking

title: Animated explainers
description: One honest question, a simple mechanism, a concrete example, and a memorable answer. Verify factual claims before export.
strength: Prominent creator examples, not format-wide comparative performance

title: Recurring character stories
description: Reuse one character and visual identity. Give the character a goal, an obstacle, a choice, and a satisfying ending.
strength: Animation audience research, not Shorts-only data

title: Animation memes & loops
description: One repeatable motion, recognizable character or shape, and sound synchronized to the movement.
strength: Documented trend; test its current relevance to your audience

title: Surreal satisfying motion
description: A simple transformation with tactile sound. Use an original reference image and animate one shot; inspect physical continuity before use.
strength: Historical trend signal, not evidence of current leadership
